what_this_is: Which English Wikipedia article each Dead Famous pool item resolves to, and whether that article is real. Pool records in data/*.json carry no wiki_title, so items are resolved by display name; a bare ambiguous name lands on a disambiguation page and scores near zero on every fame/salience metric. tools/validate_reveal.py fails the build on any status that is not 'ok'. Regenerate with: python3 tools/fame/build_salience.py
